backupTip: Please manually back up site data before restore to avoid data loss
checkFailed: Check failed, please try again later
logFallback: Live channel unavailable, switched to polling
identical: The local code matches the official code
addNotRestorable: An "Added" file only exists locally, so there is no official content to restore
compareLargeTip: Large file: comparison and rendering will be noticeably slower, and very long changed lines are marked as a whole instead of word by word.
compareLargeTruncatedTip: This file is too large, so line-level comparison is used and only the beginning of the content is shown. Differences may not be complete.
restoreConfirmTip: %count% selected file(s) (%size%) will be overwritten with the official content. Originals are backed up first.
restoreConsequenceOverwrite: The selected files are replaced by the official package content: any local customization made to them is permanently lost, because the official package does not contain those changes.
restoreConsequenceDeleted: A "Deleted" item is a file that exists officially but is missing locally — restoring it puts the file back on the site.
restoreConsequenceBackup: Originals are backed up on the server first under runtime/integrity/backup (grouped by timestamp and target); the exact path for this run is shown in the result. Backups are never cleaned automatically; you can review historical backups and restore them with one click later via "Backup Manager" in the file diff dialog.
restoreConsequenceLive: The restore takes effect immediately: the site starts using the official content. If the site is live, prefer doing this during off-peak hours.
restoreRefreshTip: The diff list does not refresh automatically. To see the latest status, close this dialog and click "Re-check".
backupEmpty: No backups yet. Backups are created automatically on the server whenever you restore official files in the file diff dialog.
backupDeleteConfirmAll: All %count% backup files of this batch will be deleted and cannot be recovered (local files are not affected). Continue?
backupDeleteConfirmSelected: The %count% selected backup files will be deleted and can no longer be restored from (local files are not affected). Continue?
backupMaxFilesTip: At most %max% files per run, but %count% selected. Please split into batches.
backupNotRestorableTip: The target cannot be resolved right now (it may be uninstalled or its version info is missing), so the restore location is unknown.
backupConfirmText: Restoring overwrites local files with the backup content: local changes to these files are lost. The current local content is backed up again before overwriting, so this step is reversible. Continue?
isBlankTip: When enabled, clicking this menu opens the page in a new tab and hides the sidebar, header and tab bar, showing only the page content

axios.404: Request error, the resource was not found
axios.505: The http version does not support the request
